This role exists to build the backend foundation that makes this possible. ## What You'll Do You will not just write services. You will **design and own core platform systems**. ### 1\. Scale the Platform Without Breaking Architecture Scale from **50K to 4M+ interactions per month**. Ensure: - High availability. - Low latency. - Fault tolerance. - Clean architectural evolution without requiring large rewrites. ### 2\. Ensure workflows: - Handle edge cases reliably. - Can be configured easily. - Move from hardcoded flows to a configurable execution engine. ### 3\. Ensure: - Incidents are handled quickly. - Root causes are fixed permanently. - Reliability is shared across the team, not dependent on individuals. ## What Success Looks Like - The platform scales to **2M+ interactions per month** smoothly. - The workflow engine supports complex, dynamic use cases. - The data layer enables fast deployment across accounts. - Edge cases are handled without constant firefighting. - The system becomes easier to use as it grows. - Production issues are rare and predictable. ## Who You Are You have built: - Scalable systems. - Distributed services. You think in terms of: - Systems. - Data models. - Trade-offs. You are comfortable owning: - Architecture. - Production systems. ## What Will Make You Stand Out Experience building: - Workflow engines. - State machines. - Data-heavy platforms. Strong understanding of: - System design. - Distributed systems. - Failure handling. Experience working in: - High-scale production environments. ## Why Join? You will build the core backend of an AI platform. Your work directly impacts: - Scale. - Reliability. - Product capability. You will design systems that evolve from **use-case-specific implementations to platform-level infrastructure**. ## What This Role Is Not - Not just API development. - Not limited to feature-level work. - Not disconnected from production realities. ## What This Role Is - A system architect. - A builder of scalable platforms. - A driver of long-term technical advantage. ## One Question to Self-Evaluate **Can you design backend systems that scale, handle edge cases, and become easier to use as they grow?**

Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

The Customer Services department within ETG is dedicated to continuously elevating the customer experience through automation, process optimization, and quality governance.

We are seeking an inquisitive, detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team in Mumbai. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in delivering actionable insights and robust reporting solutions to global stakeholders across the Customer Services organization, empowering data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

• Performance Reporting: Monitor, analyse, and report on core Customer Service KPIs and operational performance metrics across daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
• Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive productivity dashboards and visual analytics for cross-functional teams using BI tools (Qlik Sense).
• Data Management & Extraction: Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and model complex, multidimensional datasets from relational databases to fulfil ad-hoc and routine business requests.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate directly with global business leads to understand data requirements, manage inbound reporting queues, and effectively communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify operational trends, inefficiencies, and data quality gaps to assist leadership in driving automation and workflow enhancements.

Requirements

• Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in a Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Operational Reporting role (BPO / Contact Centre experience is highly advantageous).
• SQL Proficiency: Strong experience writing complex SQL queries for data extraction, aggregation, and analysis.
• BI Tools: Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards in Qlik Sense / QlikView, Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio (preferred).
• Advanced Spreadsheet Skills: Proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, including advanced formulas (INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, nested logic), pivot tables, and data modelling.
• Data Handling: Proven ability to clean, manipulate, and draw insights from large, complex, and unaggregated datasets.

Key Competencies & Behavioural Traits

• Self-Driven & Proactive: Strong sense of ownership with a desire to impact organizational success.
• Agility: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting business priorities.
• Good Communication: Able to articulate technical data findings clearly to global stakeholders at varying leadership levels.

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

Role: Senior ML Engineer – Recommendations & Personalisation
Function: Machine Learning / Data Science
Location: Gurugram
Type: Full-time
Industry: Internet / Consumer Tech / Dating & Relationships

About Company
A venture-backed, stealth-stage startup reimagining how people connect. The company is building a next-generation matchmaking platform where AI, community, and content come together.
At its core is a real-time ML recommendation engine delivering deeply personalised experiences — even in sparse data scenarios. Backed by marquee VCs in India and the US, the company has raised $10M+ at seed stage.
The team of 23 operates with the urgency and autonomy of a founding-stage environment. Founders bring extensive experience launching and scaling dating apps and global consumer internet businesses.

Position Overview
This role owns the full lifecycle of the company's matchmaking and personalisation engine — from architecture through production deployment. You will build the real-time ranking and recommendation infrastructure that makes every user's experience feel individually curated, partnering closely with Data, Product, and Backend teams to ship systems that directly define the product.

Role & Responsibilities
• Design, build, and own end-to-end matchmaking, recommendation, ranking, and personalisation systems
• Develop a real-time adaptive matchmaking engine that learns continuously from user interactions and behavioural signals
• Build user embedding systems, similarity models, and graph-based match scoring frameworks
• Architect and implement cold-start solutions to deliver quality recommendations for new users with sparse data
• Deploy models to production with fast iteration loops, model registries, and observability tooling
• Define and track offline and online evaluation frameworks, A/B tests, and metric alignment across the recommendation stack
• Partner with Data, Product, and Backend teams to translate business goals into scalable ML solutions

Must Have Criteria
• 2–5 years of hands-on experience building personalisation, recommendation, ranking, or search systems at scale
• Prior experience at a B2C product company or startup — social, e-commerce, fashion, gaming, dating, or video platforms
• Working knowledge of collaborative filtering, two-tower deep retrieval models, learning-to-rank, and embedding-based ANN search
• End-to-end ML pipeline ownership — both training models and deploying them to production
• Familiarity with offline and online evaluation methodologies, A/B testing, and metric alignment

Nice to Have
• Experience with vector search, graph-based algorithms, or LLM-based approaches for sparse data personalisation
• Prior ownership or leadership of a recsys, feed ranking, or search initiative
• Exposure to cold-start problem-solving in low-data or new-user scenarios
• Background at a high-scale B2C product or consumer startup

What We Offer
• Direct ownership of systems that are core to the product — not peripheral tooling
• Autonomy to shape ML architecture and infrastructure from the ground up
• Collaborative, experimentation-driven culture with responsive, growth-oriented founders

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!
Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.
It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.
Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Client Delivery Lead to support our German GenerationFlex clients on their Kraken onboarding journey and wider business transformation.

🐙 About GenerationFlex
The energy system is changing fast. Renewables are growing, demand is becoming more peaky, and grid constraints are showing up in more places, more often. Kraken GenerationFlex is how utilities and asset owners navigate that complexity at scale.
We help organisations run portfolios of grid-scale assets - BESS, renewables, and co-located sites - in a way that's commercially aligned, operationally safe, and practical to manage day to day.
From trading enablement and control & dispatch, to alerts, data services, and settlements, our platform gives teams the visibility and automation they need to respond well to change across multiple assets, markets, and regulations.
We're a mission-driven team making the big green dent in the world, and we're looking for people ready to help shape what that looks like next.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in: The Delivery Team
We are looking for an experienced Senior Client Delivery Lead to build industry-leading product experiences for our European clients. If you love making things better for clients, building great products, working with technology (software + hardware), bringing people together to find solutions, then you’ve come to the right place.
GenerationFlex is different to the wider Kraken universe and highly cross-functional: our product bridges software and hardware in order to allow our clients’ trading teams to effectively control their assets across multiple markets and asset types. The Senior Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility for creating, managing and prioritising the client onboarding roadmap to ensure clarity and understanding with both the Kraken and client business. They need to always work in partnership with the product, software engineering, asset onboarding and electrical engineering teams at Kraken and are the main point of contact for our clients and their partners.

🚀 What you'll own
• 
Client relationship: manage and coordinate a multitude of stakeholders during the initial client implementation phase, ranging from construction site managers to software engineers to senior business stakeholders. Be the first point of contact for tech development and issue resolution during the implementation phase, organise workstreams, flag dependencies, coordinate internal and external teams, and provide clear and concise updates to keep everyone on track and on the same page.
• 
Regional Market Expertise: act as the subject matter expert for our clients and wider Kraken teams thanks to your deep understanding of the German and European energy markets, including hardware and connectivity requirements, TSOs and DSOs, re-dispatch, ancillary-service requirements and competitor landscape. Help evaluate hardware and software solutions for regional fit.
• 
Kraken technology: Develop deep product knowledge of Kraken’s technology offering in the German and European markets, and, together with your regional market expertise, help our clients along a smooth onboarding journey. Understand our clients’ user needs and how our capabilities enable their asset management and energy trading strategies.
• 
Strategic outlook: work closely with our account managers to understand our clients’ priorities and enable strategic business reviews and client transformation workshops. Spot opportunities for product enhancements, market expansion, user growth and upselling.
• 
Internal process improvements: drive internal process improvements to enhance our onboarding journey and speed up time to value. Work closely with product, engineering, customer success and support teams to provide a smooth client experience.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party
• 
In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our client’s needs.
• 
We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winning mindset, this position is the right fit for you!
• 
Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience working across software and hardware.
• 
Experience of working with complex delivery pipelines for clients, coordinating multiple teams, spotting dependencies, mitigating risks and maintaining momentum.
• 
Exceptional relationship management across a wide range of stakeholders internally and externally: software engineers & architects, electrical engineers, C-level executives, commercial teams, project managers, product managers, cyber security experts, procurement & logistics, finance etc.
• 
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action. Ability to communicate at high-level and low-level.
• 
Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking.
• 
Strong interest in understanding the intricacies of energy markets. Experience working with flexibility products is a plus.
• 
Solid understanding of technology and associated trends. Agile delivery experience and understanding of APIs, data flows, system integrations and cloud software architecture.
• 
Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding
• 
Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude.
• 
Native or professional fluency in English. Other European languages are a plus.
• 
Occasional travel is required as part of this role.
 
⭐️ Bonus points
• 
Fluency in other (human) languages.
• 
In-depth knowledge of the energy market, in particular Germany / Europe, e.g. market players, trading practices, regulations, compliance.
• 
Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources. Commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.
• 
A working understanding of industrial gateways, edge devices, IoT connectivity, and industrial communication protocols and controlled environments (e.g. Modbus, OPC UA).

Associate Product Manager – Discover

Job Description

About the Position

As an Associate Product Manager – Discover, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Sense’s intelligent automation and agentic AI ecosystem.

You will work on some of Sense’s most strategic problem spaces, including:

• Empower recruiters to rapidly identify top-tier candidates for open job orders across ATS and Sense platforms, accelerating time to fill job orders.
• Drive higher application rates for open jobs by connecting job seekers with the most relevant jobs across Email, SMS, Voice, and Chat surfaces.
• Structured AI Decisioning out of unstructured data within automation workflows to ensure rapid yet meaningful outreach and audience engagement
• LLM-powered Recommendation and Decisioning Engines which drive above outcomes
• Reliable Feedback Loop - AI Quality, Observability & Data Quality monitoring to ensure reliable and explainable outcomes for recruiters and customers

This role sits at the intersection of AI, workflow orchestration, automation infrastructure, and recruiter productivity. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and GTM teams to conceptualize, build, and scale products that automate recruiting workflows and empower recruiters with AI-driven assistance.

This is an excellent opportunity for a high-potential Product Manager who enjoys solving complex platform and systems problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to grow into a larger product leadership role over time.

Role And Responsibilities

Strategy & Discovery 

• Identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve recruiter productivity, operational efficiency, and candidate experience.
• Work closely with Product Leadership to define and evolve the vision for Sense’s Discover roadmap. More specifically, contribute to the roadmap for:
• Candidate Matching
• Job Matching
• AI Decisioning & Actions
• AI Observability
• Stay current with advancements in Agentic AI, LLM ecosystems, workflow orchestration, and enterprise automation trends.
• Conduct structured discovery sessions with enterprise customers, recruiters, implementation, customer success, sales and leadership teams to understand and document feedback, pain points and user flow inefficiencies clearly.
Execution - Design, Development and Delivery

• Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clearly defined user flow diagrams, user stories, and acceptance criteria within a PRD - explaining aha! moments, self-serve features, guided onboarding, activation experience and instrumentation to track post launch activation and repeat usage metrics.
• Contribute to the implementation of intelligent orchestration capabilities across recruiting workflows and user journeys.
• Partner with user experience and design teams to ship consumer-grade, highly flexible yet scalable and delightful user experiences. Help define interaction patterns and experiences for features owned by your EPD triad across Voice, Chat, Recruiter Hub, Workflows, Sequences and other surfaces.
• Partner with engineering, platform and ML teams to deliver scalable, reliable and maintainable solutions across ingestion pipelines, document processing, feature extraction, data transformations & indexing, vector storage & embeddings, structured and low latency retrieval and amongst other product and platform capabilities.
• Ensure product, design and engineering decisions are documented, and shared with stakeholders in a timely manner.
• Drive feature prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination by maintaining a groomed / ungroomed backlog / project plan in Asana or Jira.
• Work closely with QA teams and perform hands-on UAT to ensure comprehensive test coverage and delivered features meet customer and usability expectations.
• Ensure customer reported issues are resolved under pre-defined SLA windows and are escalated proactively to the appropriate leadership to ensure timely resolution.
• Contribute towards shipping internal tools for engineering and customer support to easily track and debug issues.

Enablement and GTM

• Run a structured post launch program to ensure awareness, activation and adoption of key features
• Analyse past usage, revenue and churn risk signals to identify customer segments where a feature is launched and will be useful to drive targeted adoption
• Work closely with product marketing and knowledge base team to create and update the customer facing how-tos and other useful artifacts
• Create internal and customer facing announcement artifacts and adoption playbooks for customer success and implementation teams
• Run structured training sessions for new capabilities, office hours and workshops

Product Adoption and AI Observability 

• Define, review and present adoption and AI Observability metrics to stakeholders on a bi-weekly basis
• Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Synthesis
• AI Quality / Reliability / Faithfulness -
• Feature extraction accuracy
• Hit Rates, Miss Rates, Relevant Results Density
• Faithfulness of AI explanation on a sample dataset
• Indexing and Retrieval Reliability - Latency, Failure Rates, Zero Result Rates
• Conversion Funnel Analysis
• Personally inspect AI Quality - LLM outputs, traces, retrieval results, source-ingestion failures, irrelevant results, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.
• Analyse customer reported issues via bugs and support tickets and identify improvement opportunities
• Partner with Product Analytics and Data teams to ensure timely and evolving instrumentation, derive actionable insights and identify optimization opportunities on a bi-weekly basis.
Professional Qualifications

• BE/B.Tech or M.B.A with at least 1-3 years of experience in product management role with deep familiarity with software development lifecycle.
• You need to be a highly analytical problem solver to succeed in this role.
• [Must Have] - You bring hands-on experience with data analysis using SQL and present your findings in a structured way. Experience with tools like Mixpanel, Heap or Amplitude is preferred.
• [Highly Preferred] Previous experience in working closely with engineering and ML on retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, evaluations and observability. Familiarity with AI Observability tools like Arize, Braintrust etc is highly desired.
• Familiarity with project management tools like Asana or Jira.
• Proficient in English, with good written and oral communication and presentation skills
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks
• Ability to process and apply feedback constructively without ego
• Ability to “do what it takes to get the job done” - no job is small for you.

Headquarters: Remote - North America

Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build,  this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!
About the Role

We're hiring our first Senior GTM AI Engineer. This is a software engineering job inside the revenue org. You will build the pipelines, internal tools, and agents that decide which companies we go after, how we reach them, and what our sellers see when they open their laptop in the morning.

Most of what a sales ops team used to do by hand is now something you can write software to do. Finding every company building voice AI before they contact us. Researching an account and drafting the first email. Watching product usage and telling an AE when a customer is about to expand or churn. Keeping the CRM clean without anyone filling in forms. You will build those systems, run them in production, and be judged on whether pipeline and revenue move.

Your users are our AEs, SDRs, and GTM leaders. Your job is to make a small team perform like one three times its size.

What You'll Do

• Write code every day. Python services, SQL models, scheduled jobs, and small internal apps are most of the job. You'll use Claude Code and similar tools to ship in days what used to take a quarter.

• Build agents that do the work: account research, lead qualification, outreach drafting, CRM hygiene, and usage monitoring. Design them, give them tools and data, evaluate their output, and keep them running.

• Turn product usage data in BigQuery and Looker into signals sellers act on: usage alerts, expansion triggers, and account health scores.

• Build the account targeting machine: sourcing, enrichment, dedupe, and ICP scoring, from raw data to a ranked list in a rep's queue.

• Integrate the systems the team already uses (our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools) so data moves between them without a human in the loop.

• Keep funnel data trustworthy: routing rules, field governance, and attribution.

• Prototype fast, measure what works, kill what doesn't, and work directly with Sales and Marketing leadership on what to build next.

• Document what you build so it keeps running without you.

What You'll Need

• 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or growth/GTM engineer, with time spent shipping systems that other people depend on.

• Strong Python and SQL. You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring.

• Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You can tell whether an agent's output is good, and you know when a plain script is the better tool.

• AI-assisted development is how you work. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce.

• Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship.

• Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly.

• A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue.

• Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single-threaded owner of an entire domain.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay.

• dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack.

• Time at a developer-facing or API-first company, or selling to technical buyers.

• You've been the first engineer in a sales or growth org and built the function from scratch.

b723c13588968200.description: About RevOpt RevOpt is building a revenue-management platform to help hotels make better commercial decisions and grow revenue. We are hiring a hands-on Pricing & Revenue Optimization Scientist to work with our forecasting data scientist and hospitality-domain team. Our forecasting work is already underway. This role has a distinct purpose: decide what rate to recommend, under what constraints, and how to assess whether that decision works. It is not a second forecasting position, a competitor-price scraping role or a dashboard-only role. What you will do Build a first version of a hotel room-rate recommendation system using demand forecasts, on-the-books rooms, booking pace, remaining inventory and hotel-specific commercial rules. Define how rate floors and ceilings, permitted rate changes, room or segment differences, competitor signals and human approvals affect a recommendation. Investigate how booking demand may respond to changes in price, while recognising that historical prices were not set randomly. Start with clear, testable pricing logic; introduce more sophisticated optimisation where the data and product needs justify it. Simulate and evaluate recommendations against a credible baseline before putting them into a hotel’s workflow. Produce explainable outputs: the recommended rate, the principal reasons for it, the constraints applied and situations where the system should decline to recommend a change. Collaborate with our forecasting data scientist on inputs, interfaces and monitoring, and with the hospitality team on commercial logic. Implement tested, maintainable Python and SQL logic that our engineering team can integrate into RevOpt. What we are looking for Hands-on experience building a pricing, yield-management, revenue-management, inventory-allocation or decision-optimisation system—not just analysing or displaying prices. Strong Python and SQL, including the ability to work with messy operational data and write production-oriented code. Ability to state an optimisation objective, specify real business constraints and compare a proposed decision with a defensible baseline. Sound statistical judgment about evaluation, uncertainty and the limits of inferring price response from historical data. Clear communication with both technical colleagues and commercial decision-makers. Relevant experience in hotels, airlines, travel or another capacity-constrained business with perishable inventory is particularly welcome. Strong applied-pricing candidates from other sectors should also apply if they can demonstrate comparable decision-making work. Helpful experience Price-response or elasticity modelling. Constrained optimisation, simulation, experimentation or causal inference. Hotel revenue-management concepts such as occupancy, pickup, booking lead time, length of stay and rate restrictions. Designing human-reviewed recommendations before automating decisions. Important distinction Competitor-rate collection can be a useful input, but price comparison is not price optimisation. Likewise, a demand forecast alone does not determine the best room rate. We are looking for someone who can connect forecasts to constrained, measurable commercial decisions. Compensation and workplace ₹12–18 LPA CTC, depending on demonstrated experience and fit. This is a full-time, on-site role in Chennai. Please answer the below questions while applying for this position: Pricing ownership: “Describe one pricing, yield-management or optimisation system you personally built. What decision did it recommend or make, what objective did it pursue, and what were its business constraints?” Evidence of impact: “What baseline did you compare that system against, and how did you test whether its decisions improved the outcome? Please separate your contribution from the wider team’s work.” Practical fit: “Are you willing to work full-time on-site in Chennai, and is your expected annual CTC within ₹12–18 LPA?”

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.
About the team/role

Checkr Trust is not a typical sales role. It's a chance to help build an entirely new business inside a category-defining company — and we're going deep on insurance.

Checkr Trust accelerates solutions that detect bad actors before they impact businesses. We have early traction in the insurance space, strong product-market pull, and the backing of Checkr — but we are still building the plane while flying it.

We are looking for a Senior Account Executive who knows the insurance industry from the inside: the players, the pain points, the buying dynamics, and the relationships. Someone who can walk into a room with a carrier, MGA, or program administrator and immediately earn credibility — not because of a slide deck, but because of deep domain fluency and a trusted network.

This role is for someone who wants:

• A difficult, high-ownership role

• Ambiguity over predictability

• Accountability over excuses

• Long-term impact over short-term comfort

This is not a "manage a book of inbound" job. This is a territory-building, market-educating, first-call-to-close ownership role within the insurance vertical. You will operate like a founder inside a startup — except you have the resources of an established company behind you.

If you want something safe and structured, this won't be the right fit. If you want to build something enduring in insurance — and are willing to do the hard work required — keep reading.

What You'll Do

• Own the insurance vertical: define ICPs across carriers, MGAs, program administrators, and insurtech platforms — then build repeatable motion where none exists yet

• Leverage your existing insurance relationships to accelerate pipeline and shorten deal cycles

• Own the entire deal lifecycle — from cold outreach to multi-threaded enterprise close

• Educate the market on a category that is still forming, translating Checkr Trust's value into the language of underwriting, loss prevention, and claims risk

• Navigate complex insurance buying processes involving underwriting, compliance, legal, and executive stakeholders

• Experiment with AI to find efficiencies across your work

• Partner cross-functionally with product, legal, operations, and leadership to shape how we win in insurance

• Hit ambitious revenue targets

Your fingerprints will be on how Checkr Trust wins in insurance.

What We're Looking For

You are someone who:

• Has 5–7+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying sales experience — hunting required

• Has deep roots in the insurance industry

• Has sold six- or seven-figure deals in complex, multi-stakeholder environments

• Understands insurance workflows well enough to connect Checkr Trust's solutions to real underwriting and risk management problems

• Has built pipeline when there was no brand awareness in a market

• Has worked in a startup or operated like you were in one

• Has outperformed targets in situations that weren't perfectly set up for you

• Has tangible examples of projects created using advanced AI tactics

• Carries an A-player mindset: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes

More importantly:

• You have grit. Your energy and work ethic raises the bar of others

• You prefer autonomy and ownership to rigid structure

• You don't wait for perfect messaging — you test, iterate, refine

• You are comfortable hearing "no" repeatedly without losing momentum

• You care about building something meaningful, not just closing this quarter's deal

• You hold yourself to a higher internal standard than anyone else will

People describe you as relentless, disciplined, competitive — but collaborative. You understand that building something valuable in a complex, regulated industry like insurance is both rewarding and uncomfortable.
